method.distance: Exact minimum between footprint boundary edges and surface route segments, threshold 100m. Tunnels excluded using route.tunnels; not centroid distance.
method.firstRow: Normal rays every <=5m, both sides, first footprint intersection within100m; corner glimpses and longitudinal facades may be missed.
method.facade: Dominant seen edge merged with adjacent edges aligned within3 degrees to avoid half-width OSM vertex splits.
method.countUnit: OSM ways/building components, not independently surveyed physical buildings.
method.newFirstRow: First row in this loop but not first row in the immutable legacy coverage table.
